Class SshServerTest.PtyCommand

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.ssh.SshServerTest.PtyCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable, org.apache.sshd.server.command.Command, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectErrorStreamAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectInputStreamAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectOutputStreamAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandDirectStreamsAware, org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandLifecycle
Enclosing class:
SshServerTest
static class SshServerTest.PtyCommand extends Object implements org.apache.sshd.server.command.Command, Runnable
The PtyCommand class launches ollama run qwen2.5-coder:7b inside a pty4j pseudo-terminal. One thread copies SSH input into the PTY. The command thread copies PTY output back to SSH.

    • start

      public void start(org.apache.sshd.server.channel.ChannelSession channel, org.apache.sshd.server.Environment env) throws IOException
      The method starts ollama run qwen2.5-coder:7b in a pseudo-terminal and starts the pump thread. The process environment is a copy of the SSH environment. TERM is set to xterm-256color. Error output is redirected into the PTY output. Windows ANSI color is enabled. The console flag is false. The pump thread is a daemon named pty-pump.
      Specified by:
      start in interface org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandLifecycle
      Parameters:
      channel - The channel is the SSH channel that started this command. The method does not read it.
      env - The environment is the SSH environment copied into the process.
      Throws:
      IOException - The method throws this exception when the process cannot start.

    • destroy

      public void destroy(org.apache.sshd.server.channel.ChannelSession channel)
      The method destroys the process and interrupts the pump thread. A missing process or a missing thread is skipped.
      Specified by:
      destroy in interface org.apache.sshd.server.command.CommandLifecycle
      Parameters:
      channel - The channel is the SSH channel being closed.

    • run

      public void run()
      The method copies SSH input into the PTY and copies PTY output back to SSH. The input copy runs on a daemon thread named ssh-to-pty and uses an 8192 byte buffer. The output copy uses the same buffer size. When the PTY ends, the exit callback receives the process status. Any other failure uses status 1 and the exception message.
      Specified by:
      run in interface Runnable
